g.text: Scheme B — In-Rho AC Match + Fire as ONE Atomic Consume (AcDemo: PPar{A | B | C} ~> Wrap(x))
ONE atomic RSpace consume (locked; check_commit; all-or-nothing)
the bag node at exact position p
The pick/rest/guard were INTERNAL to the
single consume, so AC adds ZERO new τ steps.
Reject-safe: no partial consume is reachable.
No slot is bound, no element removed.
Provenance: OUT = Wrap(e) for a REAL e ∈ {A,B,C} even when the host report σ is
subject's spread, never find_sigma. Zero host residue: the whole match AND fire are in Rho.
